plain_english_revision: This amendment adds a contingency clause to the bill. It states that if the Alabama Legislature does not pass all necessary enabling legislation by the date of the ratification vote on this constitutional amendment, then the entire amendment will become void regardless of how voters decide in the election.
candidate_position_supported: This amendment advances the policy effect of ensuring that a proposed constitutional amendment is only implemented if all required legislative actions are completed prior to the ratification vote. This aims to prevent incomplete or rushed implementation of significant legal changes.
evidence_quotes: In the event the Legislature has failed to pass all required enabling legislation by the date of the ratification vote on this amendment, the amendment shall be void, irrespective of the outcome of the election.
review_reason: The amendment text is clear and specific about its intent to add a contingency clause for legislative action prior to ratification. No further context or unseen language is required to understand its effect.
